25		return &WASMCompiler{tinyGoPath: tinyGoPath, outDir: outDir}
26	}

28	func (c *WASMCompiler) Compile(ctx context.Context, source string, wasmType WASMType) (*CompileResult, error) {
29		os.MkdirAll(c.outDir, 0755)
30	
31		srcFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", fmt.Sprintf("heart_%s_*.go", wasmType))
32		if err != nil {
33			return nil, err
34		}
35		defer os.Remove(srcFile.Name())
36		if _, err := srcFile.WriteString(source); err != nil {
37			return nil, err
38		}
39		srcFile.Close()
40	
41		outPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d.wasm", wasmType, time.Now().Unix()))
42	
43		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, c.tinyGoPath, "build", "-o", outPath, "-target", "wasm", srcFile.Name())
44		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("tinygo compile: %w\nstderr: %s", err, string(out))
47		}
48	
49		data, _ := os.ReadFile(outPath)
50		hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
51	
52		hashHex := hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
53		finalPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, hashHex+".wasm")
54		os.Rename(outPath, finalPath)
55	
56		return &CompileResult{WASMPath: finalPath, WASMHash: hashHex}, nil
57	}
